Here, $X$ is a $1\times 3$ matrix and $Y$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $3$ columns in $X$ and $3$ rows in $Y,$ so $X$ and $Y$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{X}_{1\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{Y}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 2}={XY}_{1\times 2}
$$

Let's compute $XY,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}22 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,22=5\cdot 2+(-2)\cdot (-2)+4\cdot 2 \\  & [\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}22 & 9\end{aligned}], &  & \,9=5\cdot 3+(-2)\cdot 1+4\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$XY=[\begin{aligned}22 & 9\end{aligned}].$
